data.summary: This script validates **Municipal Waste & Recycling Collection Schedules (Blue Box / Green Cart)**. It queries address custom fields, checks collection calendars, and returns schedule lookup responses.
js_behaviors: Registers BUI Extension Loader hooks (`ORACLE_SERVICE_CLOUD.extension_loader`) and binds workspace record events.
Attaches dynamic workspace field value change listeners to trigger real-time search and validation as fields are edited.
Loads ArcGIS JavaScript API components for map rendering and geocoding coordinate selection.
